name: Engineering Digital Opportunity Score (EDOS)
philosophy: A digital gap is only an opportunity when the company can pay AND has a reason to act.
Scoring gap alone selects for companies that are indifferent to marketing, not companies that will buy.
Every point must trace to an observable signal. No signal, no points - and the missing signal is recorded.

financial_capacity.question: Can this company absorb a R15k-R40k/month retainer or a R25k+ project without a board decision?

portfolio_quality.question: Do they have work worth telling stories about?

org_readiness.question: Is there anyone to brief us, approve work and pay the invoice?

trigger_event.question: Has something happened in the last 6 months that creates a need to be seen?

competitive_pressure.question: Are visible competitors already publishing well? That is the argument that closes the sale.

marketing_intent.question: Is there ANY evidence they already believe marketing matters? This is the single best predictor of a sale.

rules.note: No site at all is a moderate not maximum score - often means no intent
Zero posts scores 6 not 8. A page that has never posted is often a page nobody owns. 1-2 posts scores highest: proof of intent plus obvious gap.

immersive_3d_fit.deliberately_small_because: No evidence of B2B conversion lift from WebGL sites was found. Three.js was detected on roughly 3585 active domains globally in March 2025 (source S17). Treat 3D as a differentiator for OUR pitch, not as a demonstrated client need.

modifiers.name: intent_gate
modifiers.rationale: A large gap with no trigger and no marketing intent is an indifference signal, not an opportunity. This is the correction that stops the score selecting for companies that will never buy.

modifiers.name: no_decision_maker_identified
modifiers.rationale: An unreachable prospect is not a prospect.

modifiers.name: language_or_geography_friction
modifiers.rationale: Applies mainly to DRC prospects served from South Africa.

bands.label: Very high priority
bands.action: Build a custom sample before contact. Personal approach.

bands.label: High priority
bands.action: Personalised outreach with a mini digital audit.

bands.label: Medium
bands.action: Add to nurture list. Contact when a trigger appears.

band_calibration_warning: These thresholds are provisional and ordinal. They rank prospects against each other; they do not predict conversion. Recalibrate after 50 audited companies and 20 real outreach outcomes by checking which score bands actually produced meetings.

confidence.note: Every score carries a completeness ratio: signals observed / signals required. Do not act on a score whose completeness is below 0.6.
